# `/outlier-summaries` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /outlier-summaries/v1

`getIdentityOutlierSnapshotsV1` — Iai identity outliers summary — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API returns a summary containing the number of identities that customer has, the number of outliers, and the type of outlier.

- Scopes: iai:outliers:manage, iai:outliers:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, REPORT_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `type` (query) — one of LOW_SIMILARITY, STRUCTURAL — Type of the identity outliers snapshot to filter on
  - `filters` (query) — fields: snapshotDate: ge, le — e.g. `snapshotDate ge "2022-02-07T20:13:29.356648026Z"`
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: snapshotDate — e.g. `snapshotDate`
- Returns 200: array of outliersummary

### GET /outlier-summaries/v1/latest

`getLatestIdentityOutlierSnapshotsV1` — Iai identity outliers latest summary — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API returns a most recent snapshot of each outlier type, each containing the number of identities that customer has, the number of outliers, and the type of outlier.

- Scopes: iai:outliers:manage, iai:outliers:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, REPORT_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `type` (query) — one of LOW_SIMILARITY, STRUCTURAL — Type of the identity outliers snapshot to filter on
- Returns 200: array of latestoutliersummary
